turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How's the self-serve dashboard experience been overall?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Pretty intuitive, our non-technical team members were able to generate and manage voices without engineering help, which was the whole point for us.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Anything you'd still want changed in the dashboard?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Search within our generated audio library is basically just filename matching — a way to search by transcript content would save a lot of scrolling.
